installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

APP_ID="${SRCDS_APPID:-1936830}"
BRANCH="${SRCDS_BETAID:-public}"
INSTALL_DIR="/mnt/server"
STEAMCMD_DIR="${INSTALL_DIR}/steamcmd"

echo "=================================================="
echo " nanos world Dedicated Server - Installation"
echo " Maintained by Yuketsu / YuketsuSh"
echo " App ID : ${APP_ID}"
echo " Branch : ${BRANCH}"
echo "=================================================="

mkdir -p "${INSTALL_DIR}" "${STEAMCMD_DIR}"
cd /tmp

curl -fsSL "https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz" -o steamcmd.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C "${STEAMCMD_DIR}"

export HOME="${INSTALL_DIR}"
cd "${STEAMCMD_DIR}"

if [[ "${BRANCH}" == "public" ]]; then
    ./steamcmd.sh \
        +force_install_dir "${INSTALL_DIR}" \
        +login anonymous \
        "+app_update ${APP_ID} -beta public" validate \
        +quit
else
    ./steamcmd.sh \
        +force_install_dir "${INSTALL_DIR}" \
        +login anonymous \
        "+app_update ${APP_ID} -beta bleeding-edge" validate \
        +quit
fi

mkdir -p "${INSTALL_DIR}/.steam/sdk32" "${INSTALL_DIR}/.steam/sdk64"
[[ -f "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux32/steamclient.so" ]] && cp -f "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux32/steamclient.so" "${INSTALL_DIR}/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so"
[[ -f "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux64/steamclient.so" ]] && cp -f "${STEAMCMD_DIR}/linux64/steamclient.so" "${INSTALL_DIR}/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so"

if [[ ! -f "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServer.sh" ]]; then
    echo "[FATAL] SteamCMD finished but NanosWorldServer.sh is missing."
    find "${INSTALL_DIR}" -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort | head -100
    exit 1
fi

chmod +x "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServer.sh"
[[ -f "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServer" ]] && chmod +x "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServer"
[[ -f "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServerTracy" ]] && chmod +x "${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServerTracy"

echo "Installation completed successfully."
echo "Found: ${INSTALL_DIR}/NanosWorldServer.sh"
